title: Königsberg Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Königsberg Cathedral exterior:asymmetric detailed westwork,octagonal clock drum/green concave spire,north/central gables,steep dark long roof,broader nave/narrower choir,paired pointed windows,mapped buttresses,two minor turrets and open northeast Kant tomb colonnade. Exact inscriptions/sculpture/tracery,full interiors and certified walking excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Unscaled current main,26 parts and northeast tomb map plans around named organ hall/Kant museum/tomb POIs. Signed western facade/eastern choir/southern tall spire resolved with pictures;exact-QID polygon identity remains unverified.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Current unscaled PMTiles main outline,26 building-part controls and northeast tomb plan define horizontal fit. Tower20m,spire50.75m,nave8m,choir11m,roof turret26m and east turret14m are mapped tags,not independent surveyed dimensions. Nave/choir tags are used as eaves with estimated24m continuous ridge;west gables26/25m,octagonal drum30m and spire subdivisions are picture-led estimates. Tomb5m tag conflicts with tall pictured columns;10.4m entablature is an explicit picture-led override. Preserve uncertainty;no exact-QID footprint claim.

Exterior approximation from four useful pictures and standard PMTiles/DEM. Nave/choir height tags are interpreted as eaves;estimated ridge and gable/clock-drum subdivisions,paired lancets,west blind-panel cadence,tomb height/columns/screen and roof vents are picture-led. No exact historical tracery,lettering,clock numerals,sculpture,full interiors or certified walking. Absolute altitude/thresholds and physical device timings pending.

Skyline preserves principal masses and open tomb bays with simplified buttresses/columns. District adds shared surfaces,flat pointed windows/closed door,blind panels/clocks and cornice rhythm. Street opens real facade recesses with mullions;closeup/master refine frames,clock marks and roof vents. Curvature,windows,ornament and tomb-column cadence change visibly. Synthetic cottage neighbors are diagnostic context,not local map buildings.
importReason: Four browser levels preserve asymmetric westwork,long steep nave/choir roof,green southern spire and open northeast tomb at their approximate reviewed geographic position.
